bullets.text: Google's AI Scraping Controversy - **Google** may allow publishers to opt out of content scraping for AI Overviews amid UK regulatory scrutiny.
Apple's Location Privacy Boost - New **Apple** feature limits precise location data shared with carriers to enhance user privacy.
Apple TV's Crime Thriller Returns - **Apple TV** announces season 2 of 'Criminal Record', premiering April 22, 2026.
Nothing Expands Retail Presence - **Nothing** plans to open flagship stores in New York City and India, enhancing its retail strategy.
Apple's Record iPhone Quarter - **Apple** reports its best-ever iPhone quarter, with sales reaching $85 billion, driven by strong demand.
Waymo's Robotaxi Service Launch - **Waymo** begins operating robotaxis to and from San Francisco International Airport, expanding its service.
Apple Acquires AI Startup Q.ai - **Apple** purchases Q.ai for $2 billion, enhancing its capabilities in audio and machine learning.
